title: fix(spec,core): the rolling last_N_days presets close on {today} at the spec table, the save door's prescription and core's analytics preset arm
body:
Fixes #23170
Clause-②: no (no accept set widens: the three rolling windows gain the inclusive `{today}` end every calendar preset already has)

## What this does

The three rolling presets (`last_7_days`, `last_30_days`, `last_90_days`) were the open arm of `DATE_RANGE_PRESET_MACRO_WINDOWS`: `end: null`, prescribed to authors as `{ $gte: '{N_days_ago}' }`. A `$gte`-only window has no upper bound, so on a column that carries future dates it counted every later day as well. Triage's direction (comment 6139344728), applied here: the three rows become `['{N_days_ago}', '{today}']` and the `end: null` arm is retired. The refusal's prescription names the window with both its bounds, and core's analytics preset arm selects the same extent, keeping its own end spelling.

One extent at all three faces: from the start of the day N days ago through the end of today, in the reference timezone.

| Face | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| spec table `DATE_RANGE_PRESET_MACRO_WINDOWS` | `['{30_days_ago}', null]` | `['{30_days_ago}', '{today}']` |
| save-door prescription `bareDateRangePresetComparandMessage` | `e.g. { $gte: '{30_days_ago}' }` | `e.g. { $between: ['{30_days_ago}', '{today}'] }` |
| core `resolveAnalyticsDateRangePreset` | end = the reference instant, `endExclusive: false` | end = the start of tomorrow in the reference zone, `endExclusive: true` (token `tomorrow`, the same end `today` already uses) |

Files in the claimed surface:
- `packages/spec/src/data/date-range-presets.ts`: the three rolling rows, the table type (`end: string`), the docblock (the open-arm paragraph is replaced by "every entry closes"), and the prescription (the `end === null` branch is gone, so the message always uses the `$between` pair).
- `packages/spec/src/data/date-range-presets.test.ts`: the rolling rows are pinned to their `{today}` end. The extent test now covers the rolling rows: their token days and expected windows on the reference day, and day counts of 8, 31 and 91. Also new: the card's measurement as a pin, and a pin that the prescription is the closed `$between`.
- `packages/core/src/utils/analytics-date-range.ts`: the rolling rows of `PRESET_WINDOW_TOKENS` become `['N_days_ago', 'tomorrow']`, the type becomes `endBefore: string`, the NOW arm is removed, and the docblocks change to match.
- `packages/core/src/utils/analytics-date-range.test.ts`: the NOW pins are retired. New pins: every preset is `endExclusive`; a rolling window ends where `today` ends in every sweep zone; the card's measurement at this face; a row later today than the reference instant is inside. The `#17341` sweep now iterates all thirteen presets, the rolling ones included.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-preset-comparands.test.ts`: the verbatim verdict pin now reads `its window is { $between: ['{30_days_ago}', '{today}'] }`.
- `.changeset/23170-rolling-presets-close-on-today.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch and `@objectstack/core` patch.

## Claim amendment 6141817295: two out-of-surface pins of the old extent (test expectations only, no source change)

- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/analytics-date-range-conformance.test.ts`: the preview test now asserts `endExclusive` true, with the last instant of today inside and the first instant of tomorrow outside. The executor test pins `[2026-08-10T00:00:00.000Z, 2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z, true]`, and `previousPeriod` is unchanged at `2026-07-10` to `2026-08-09`.
- `packages/verify/src/dashboard-window.test.ts:190`: the pin now reads `{ $gte: '{7_days_ago}', $lte: '{today}' }`.

## Claim amendment 6142517145: text this change made false, corrected in this round (no behaviour change except item g's dead branch)

- **(a)** `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`, the `os explain filter-preset-comparand` paragraph.
  - BEFORE: "which the verdict names — a rolling preset is `{ $gte: START }`, a calendar one `{ $between: [START, END] }` — or an ISO date."
  - AFTER: "which the verdict names — `{ $between: [START, END] }`, its first day through its last, and a rolling preset's last day is `{today}` — or an ISO date."
- **(b)** `packages/core/src/utils/analytics-date-range-conformance.ts`, the finding sentences.
  - The `ROLLING` docblock. BEFORE: "The three presets whose upper bound is NOW rather than a calendar boundary." AFTER: "The three rolling presets: their window runs through today and stops before tomorrow begins."
  - The `@param options` note. BEFORE: "the rolling presets (whose bound is NOW)". AFTER: "every preset, each anchored on that instant's calendar day".
  - The finding text. BEFORE: "rolling window ends at NOW and REACHES its bound". AFTER: "rolling window stops BEFORE tomorrow begins, as today does".
- **(c)** Docblocks and comments in driver-memory and service-analytics source.
  - `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-analytics.ts`. BEFORE: "The three rolling `last_N_days` presets end at NOW and stay INCLUSIVE." AFTER: "…stop where `'today'` stops, at tomorrow's midnight, with `endExclusive: true` as well."
  - `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts`. BEFORE: "the ten calendar presets report the first instant AFTER the window … The three rolling presets end at NOW, a moment they REACH, so their bound is already the last day." AFTER: "every preset reports the first instant AFTER the window (`this_month` ends at the next month's start, and a rolling `last_N_days` window at tomorrow's start) …".
  - Found by the sweep, same claim and same class (see Sweep below):
    - `packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/native-sql-strategy.ts`. BEFORE: "the three rolling ones end at NOW and reach it (`$lte`)". AFTER: "every preset stops BEFORE its end instant (`$lt`), the three rolling ones before tomorrow begins, as `today` does".
    - `packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/objectql-strategy.ts`. BEFORE: "while the three rolling ones end at NOW, a moment they reach". AFTER: "every preset stops BEFORE its end instant … the three rolling ones before tomorrow begins, as `today` does".
- **(d)** `packages/verify`.
  - `dashboard-window.ts:22-23`. BEFORE: "its first and last day, inclusive, the last open for the three rolling `last_N_days` presets". AFTER: "its first and last day, inclusive; the three rolling `last_N_days` presets end on `{today}`".
  - `dashboard-window.ts:554`. BEFORE: "first and last day inclusive, the rolling end open". AFTER: "first and last day inclusive (every preset names its last day)".
  - Found by the sweep: `packages/verify/README.md:161`, which ships in the package's `files`. BEFORE: "e.g. `{ $gte: '{7_days_ago}' }`". AFTER: "e.g. `{ $gte: '{7_days_ago}', $lte: '{today}' }`".
- **(e)** `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx:2035-2036`. BEFORE: "(`{ $gte: '{7_days_ago}' }` for `last_7_days`, …)". AFTER: "(`{ $gte: '{7_days_ago}', $lte: '{today}' }` for `last_7_days`, …)".
- **(f)** Two driver-memory test comments.
  - `memory-analytics-date-range-timezone.test.ts`. BEFORE: "that leg ends at NOW … (`endExclusive` is false for the rolling family …)". AFTER: "that leg stops before tomorrow begins, as `today` does … (`endExclusive` is true for every preset; …)".
  - `memory-analytics-date-range-conformance.test.ts:35`. BEFORE: "Frozen so the three rolling presets, whose bound is NOW, are comparable." AFTER: "Frozen so the presets, every one anchored on NOW's calendar day, are comparable."
- **(g)** `packages/lint/src/validate-preset-comparands.ts:301`, the dead branch.
  - BEFORE: `end === null ? '{ $gte: …}' : '{ $between: […] }'`. AFTER: `'{ $between: […] }'`.
  - Proved unreachable on the merged head before removal, three ways:
    - Type level: in lint's program, `null extends (typeof DATE_RANGE_PRESET_MACRO_WINDOWS)[DateRangePreset][1]` resolves to `unreachable`, and `tsc` exits 0. The control, asserting `reachable`, fails with TS2322 (exit 2).
    - Runtime: 13 presets in the built table, 0 `null` ends, 13 `string` ends.
    - Producers: `presetComparandVerdict` takes its `end` only from the table, its one call site is `finding()`, and no site in the tree assigns into the table.
- **Pending release note** `.changeset/pre/15953-verify-dashboard-window-family.md:15`. This is an in-place correction of the quoted window only, and the 63-byte frontmatter is byte-identical. BEFORE: "as written (`{ $gte: '{7_days_ago}' }`, …)". AFTER: "as written (`{ $gte: '{7_days_ago}', $lte: '{today}' }`, …)".

**Sweep.** `git grep` was run over the tree (CHANGELOGs and `content/docs/releases/**` excluded) for sentences that state the rolling end as NOW, open or `$gte`-only. Every hit is either edited (above) or true as written:
- The `.changeset/23170-*` lines describe the before-state.
- `{ $gte: '{30_days_ago}' }` in filter examples and tests is an authored macro filter, not a preset's window: `date-macros.zod.ts`, `skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md`, the lint, objectql and spec test fixtures, and the measured positive control in `validate-preset-comparands.ts:91`.
- "the measurement that found the open arm" in this PR's own tests is history.
- `open arm` in the component-type, flow-template and messaging files is an unrelated sense of the phrase.
- `analytics-date-range.ts:64` ("An end at NOW would drop …") is a counterfactual that is true.

## Why `check-empty-changeset` is red, by design

`node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` refuses this PR by name under the foreign changeset rule (ruling D on #17712), because the PR changes `.changeset/pre/15953-verify-dashboard-window-family.md`, a note it did not add. The rule names two classes with opposite remedies, and this PR is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class: "your change may have made this PENDING release note false, and you rewrote it in the same stroke. Remedy: do NOT restore it -- say so on the PR and get it confirmed; restoring it from the base would put the false sentence back." The note is pending: the `18.0.0-next.0` release consumed it into `.changeset/pre/`, and it is aggregated into the stable `18.0.0` notes at pre exit. Its sentence quoted the rolling window as `{ $gte: '{7_days_ago}' }`, which this PR makes false, so it is corrected in place and the red is left standing. The confirmation is the PR comment that names the gate.

## Acceptance notes

- `ResolvedAnalyticsDateRange.endExclusive` is now `true` for every value the preset resolver returns. The field stays, because each face's array arm still produces `endExclusive: false` for a caller's explicit window.
- The rolling windows span N+1 calendar days (`last_7_days` covers 8), which is the extent the console's lowering already selects. That was triage's ruling, and it is pinned as such.
- `packages/verify/src/dashboard-window.ts` still carries `$lte`-absent arms (`selects`, `nestedIn`, and the `to ?` spread at the condition build). The closed table no longer feeds them. They are left as is because the amendment covers comments only in that file.
- The CLI integration-tier test `test/verify-dashboard-windows.test.ts` is declared to CI.
- `origin/main` moved 12 commits after this merge, and 7 gate-input files changed there. None of them is a family that reads a path this diff touches. The queue rebuilds on current `main`.
